reason: The README presents the plugin primarily as an academic literature research suite, combining cross-database paper search, full-text retrieval, citation support, and scientific figure tools through external scholarly services.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨多个学术数据库的论文搜索、全文阅读、引用整理和科学图表工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with academic paper search across multiple databases, full-text reading, citation assistance, and scientific figure tools.

capabilities: Searches academic literature across Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, bioRxiv, and medRxiv
Retrieves paper metadata, citations, references, author information, recommendations, and full-text content
Downloads and extracts text from accessible papers using DOI or repository identifiers
Generates citations, reference lists, BibTeX, and scientific figures
Connects to the external ai4scholar.net service using a configured API key
Displays account credit and usage information
